learning_outcomes.text: Assess the strength and stiffness of machine parts with complex stress state and complex structure with high degree of redundancy.

syllabus_topics: Introduction in the theory of stress and strain
Fundamentals in matrix methods of structure mechanics
teaching_methods: Practical classes (problem-solving using computers and computer software)

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (two problems and three questions)

assessment_rules: Students can voluntarily participate in three tests; if the gained grade is above 50% of the maximum, it leads to a final grade allowing students to skip the exam. The exam consists of two problems and three questions. The semester grade is accounted for in the final grade of the exam. Regular attendance of classes and course task submission are requirements for semester passing approval.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
